selector.rationale: Diffuse medium masses in the right atrium and significantly increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium support lymphoma involvement

rejected.label: Chemotherapy-Induced Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Normal serum troponin I level and lack of evidence for cardiomyopathy

rejected.label: Cardiac Amyloidosis
rejected.why: No specific evidence for amyloidosis, such as characteristic echocardiogram findings or biopsy results

rejected.label: Restrictive Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings for restrictive cardiomyopathy, such as thickened ventricular walls or diastolic dysfunction

rejected.label: Cardiac Lymphoma
rejected.why: While cardiac lymphoma is a consideration, atrial involvement of lymphoma is more specific and supported by the presence of masses in the right atrium
